dogecoin.text: @elonmusk Everyone loves Dogecoin because it's named after a dog and dogs are known for their loyalty. Mr. Musk, help Dodge.
@elonmusk @DOGE Dogecoin needs your help. Mr. Elon Musk is waiting for your move. Value Dogecoin.
@elonmusk @DOGE The value of Dogecoin is not this, give it value so that the soul of that dog is happy.
@elonmusk @DOGE Mr. Elon Musk, it's time to value Dogecoin and prove its loyalty.
